faq: When is the Flagler Beach Holiday Parade?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 1 PM, with Skydiving Santa arriving at the same time.

Along the route from North 6th Street to South 6th Street.
Is it free to watch?
Yes, Visit Flagler lists the parade as free.
Who organizes it?
The Rotary Club of Flagler Beach sponsors and organizes the parade.

Yes, the city posted a parade traffic plan on its news page.

Yes, the Santa Claus Party follows at 2 PM and the Palm Coast Holiday Boat Parade lights up the Intracoastal at 6 PM.

The city and Visit Flagler both describe a Skydiving Santa who arrives at 1 PM.

About one hour, from 1 to 2 PM.

Where is the traffic plan?
On the City of Flagler Beach news page, posted November 25.
